units.title: Approach to Pancytopenia: Marrow Cellularity Flowchart & Aplastic Anemia Overview
units.sec: Approach to Pancytopenia: Marrow Cellularity Flowchart & Aplastic Anemia Overview
units.guide:
Diseases: aplastic anemia, MDS, pure red cell aplasia, myelophthisis (secondary myelofibrosis); workup: bone marrow aspiration + biopsy → cellularity.
Hypercellular arm: acute leukemia (unless proven otherwise; adults AML 80%/ALL 20%), MDS, PMF, hairy cell leukemia (good prognosis), megaloblastic anemia (good prognosis), PNH, systemic (SLE, HIV, TB, brucellosis, leishmaniasis, sarcoidosis).
Hypocellular arm: + pancytopenia (aplastic anemia, 20% of MDS, aleukemic leukemia, copper deficiency, lymphoma); ± pancytopenia (Q fever, Legionella, anorexia, TB); PMF = pancytopenia + fibrosis; hairy cell = pancytopenia + massive splenomegaly.
Aplastic anemia intro: p121 prints 'hypercellular' as a slip (flowchart and p123 show hypocellular); bimodal (inherited <20 yrs, acquired >60 yrs); m/c cause drug dependent (good prognosis); m/c infection non-A, non-B hepatitis; 'bad prognosis' as printed.

units.title: Inherited vs Acquired Aplastic Anemia: Fanconi, Dyskeratosis Congenita, Shwachman-Diamond
units.sec: Inherited vs Acquired Aplastic Anemia: Fanconi, Dyskeratosis Congenita, Shwachman-Diamond
units.guide:
Inherited: Fanconi (AR, FANCA > FANCB/FANCC, complex DNA-repair defect; short stature, café au lait macules, gonadal dysgenesis, ↑ AML & head-neck SCC, esophageal atresia; panels A facies, B hand/thumb anomaly, C chromosome breakage), dyskeratosis congenita (DKC mutation, telomere repair; captioned photos reticular skin pigmentation and dystrophic nails), Shwachman-Diamond (ribosomopathy; pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, metaphyseal dysplasia).
Acquired: idiopathic (m/c), drugs, toxins (benzene), virus (non-A, B, C hepatitis), others (PNH), autoimmune eosinophilic fasciitis (scleroderma mimic).

units.title: Drugs Causing Aplastic Anemia, Presentation, Severity Criteria & Treatment
units.sec: Drugs Causing Aplastic Anemia, Presentation, Severity Criteria & Treatment
units.guide:
Dose dependent (anticancer → temporary myelosuppression): fluorouracil, mercaptopurine, doxorubicin, cyclophosphamide, busulfan; dose independent: chloramphenicol, sulfonamides, gold, acetazolamide, PTU, D-penicillamine.
Presentation bleeding (m/c) > anemia > infection; features against diagnosis: hepatomegaly, splenomegaly, lymphadenopathy, fever.
Severe thresholds (as printed): Hb <9 g/dl, reticulocyte <30.0 × 10⁹/L, ANC <0.5 × 10⁹/L, platelet <30.0 × 10⁹/L → Rx AHSCT; marrow hypocellular with fat cells; treatment equine ATG + cyclosporine (6 months to act, 50% success), AHSCT, eltrombopag (TPO analogue).

units.title: Pure Red Cell Aplasia & MDS Overview: Global Versus India Presentation
units.sec: Pure Red Cell Aplasia & MDS Overview: Global Versus India Presentation
units.guide:
PRCA: acquired thymoma/CLL; transient aplastic crisis = sudden reticulocytopenia, giant pronormoblasts on smear, Rx IVIG.
MDS AKA myeloid neoplasm: dysplasia + ineffective erythropoiesis; MDS/MPN overlap = CMML; myeloblast proliferation = AML.
Global 70 yrs, M > F, single/multilineage vs India 40–60 yrs (5q deletion), female predominance, RBC-lineage disease, lenalidomide good response; hypercellular 80%/hypocellular 20%; AML progression 25%; no EMH; fatigue m/c.
RBC parameters: anemia (m/c), ringed sideroblasts (SF3B1), oval macrocytes (m/c), megaloblasts/nucleated RBCs, HJ bodies/basophilic stippling/Cabot rings; Perls staining image.

units.title: MDS Blood Parameters, Prognostic Scoring & Treatment Flowchart
units.sec: MDS Blood Parameters, Prognostic Scoring & Treatment Flowchart
units.guide:
WBC: blasts 5–19%, pseudo-Pelger-Huët (2 lobes), hypersegmented, toxic granules, Döhle bodies; platelet images: pawn-ball multinucleated, binucleate and dysplastic megakaryocytes.
Diagnostic features: pancytopenia with >10% dysplastic cells, hypocellular, cytogenetic abnormality, no AML, no other cause; R-IPSS named; prognosis poor = 7q deletion/monosomy 7 (paediatric), good = 5q/20q deletion, best = 11q deletion.
Treatment: single lineage → 5q deletion present lenalidomide / absent erythropoietin; trilineage → bone marrow transplantation or hypomethylating agent (azacytidine, decitabine).
